text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Today's finally the last day of 
the 'Summer Training Camp' huh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi... Maya's engines were running at 
full blast too, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"So on the bus ride back... I'm gonna... 
rest a little bit... okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll wake up properly... I promise...

"...And so, this year too, I decided to 
let her get some rest inside the bus."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Time for school already...? 
*Yaaawn*... Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Maya got loooots of sleep on the 
bus. So I can totally handle extra 
training... okay...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: So it was Narita Brian, huh.
So it was Narita Brian, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yes, that should be the case, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...It was sparkling so much. It was 
dazzling and flickering."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan. Actually, I think I want 
to go train right now. That's fine, right?

And after rubbing her eyes a few times, 
she dashed off toward the training 
grounds.
